svg.aria-label: State diagram: Robot 1 + CNC (Setup 2, dual gripper A / B)
svg.text: State diagram: Robot 1 + CNC (Setup 2, dual gripper A / B)
Gripper A carries the raw part, gripper B the finished part. The raw part is picked while the CNC is still machining.

From any state: timeout or a

svg.text: F FAULT and H HOLD can be entered from any state. FAULT = a confirmation is missing or a timeout
expired (the alarm names the sensor, no automatic robot retries). HOLD = LINE STOP from the cross-check
supervisor: the robot finishes the running step, parks, and continues from there after the reset.
